summary: Phase 2 backend + frontend spot-check for TaxSimba submission workflow + accountant privacy. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_taxsimba_phase2.py (37 tests) — 36 pass, 1 fail. The failure is a real backend privacy leak: GET /api/documents returns client_user_id to ACCOUNTANT (protected field not scrubbed). Full lifecycle (create → assign → start-review → request → client upload → V1 → admin-return → V2 → admin-approve → client-approve → READY_FOR_SUBMISSION → record-submission → SUBMITTED → mark-completed → COMPLETED) passes end-to-end, admin_approved_by/at and completed_at/completed_by_name are persisted, GET /api/cases/{id}/submission returns the record. All negative paths pass: record-submission is 400 when not READY_FOR_SUBMISSION / when client approval missing / when awaiting-assignment; complete is 400 unless SUBMITTED; accountant record-submission and complete both 403; raw-API stage skipping (submit-for-admin-review from ASSIGNED, admin-approve from ACCOUNTANT_REVIEW, client-approve from ASSIGNED, start-review on advanced case) all rejected with 400/403 by ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS. Privacy scrubbing verified clean on /cases (list+detail), /tasks, /messages, /activity, /notes, /calculations, /reviews, /submission, /notifications, /stats/accountant. Accountant blocked (403) from /users, /users?role=CLIENT, /accountants/workload, /audit-log, and from other accountants' cases. Activity log carries action, user_name, role, previous_status, new_status, comments, created_at — verified on transitions including CHANGES_REQUIRED (instructions in comments), SUBMITTED, COMPLETED. Client sees only admin-approved calc versions. Deactivated user login rejected 401 (iter-1 fix confirmed) and existing token rejected on /auth/me. Frontend spot-check: admin dashboard renders ALL 12 admin-card-* testids with numeric values, click navigates to /admin/cases?bucket=..., accountant dashboard renders ALL 10 acc-card-* testids, and case workspace has record-submission-btn, confirm-submission-btn, mark-completed-btn, confirm-complete-btn, approve-note, submit-admin-note, overview-submission, client-submission-info.

critical.issue: Accountant response leaks client_user_id (protected field). server.py list_documents returns clean_many(docs) — never passes docs through scrub_many. Fix: return scrub_many(clean_many(docs), user).

minor.issue: Only /cases list and /cases/{id} GET apply scrub_many/scrub. Other accountant-visible endpoints (/tasks, /messages, /notes, /activity, /calculations, /reviews, /notifications, /submission) happen to be safe today only because their payloads do not contain PROTECTED_CLIENT_FIELDS. If any of these payload shapes ever gain a client contact field, they will silently leak. Consider a global response middleware or applying scrub_many() defensively at every accountant-facing endpoint.

ui_bugs.issue: Spec lists 10 tabs (Needs My Action / New Assigned / In Progress / Waiting for Client / Changes Required / Awaiting Admin Review / Approved-Ready / Completed / Due Today / Due This Week). Frontend TABS array only contains 8 entries — acc-tab-due_today and acc-tab-due_week are missing (their cards exist but the tab bar buttons are not rendered).

Add acc-tab-due_today and acc-tab-due_week entries to the TABS array in /app/frontend/src/pages/staff/AccountantDashboard.jsx (cards already exist, only bar-tabs missing).

rca of the issue: GET /api/documents (server.py:677) returns docs via clean_many() only. scrub_many() is invoked only at /cases list (line 277) and scrub() at /cases/{id} (line 320). documents payload schema stores client_user_id per row (line 384, 716). Because ACCOUNTANT payloads are not passed through scrub_many(), every document row leaks client_user_id. Fix: wrap the return with scrub_many, i.e. `return scrub_many(clean_many(docs), user)` — one line. Same defensive pattern should ideally be applied to /tasks, /messages, /notes, /activity, /reviews, /calculations, /submission, /notifications to prevent regressions in future schema changes.
